<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: unverified — Screenshot at 375px is not part of the diff. The card layout looks sound: 2-column grid, name and Weakest part full width, overflow visible, nowrap reset.
- A2: unverified — The new rules sit inside the max-width 640px block and the labels carry `hidden`, so the desktop layout should be unchanged. Needs before and after screenshots at 768px and 1280px.
- A3: met — Each value has its column name as visible label text in the phone layout, and the thead stays in the DOM. The athlete Link and the Score component are unchanged.
- A4: unverified — No axe run is in the diff.

<details><summary>1 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Tests read source text, not rendered output `src/app/cloud/trends/compare-table.test.ts` — Add a render test of CompareRow inside a table that asserts the label text, link href and Score word.

</details>

suggestions.title: Tests read source text, not rendered output
suggestions.detail: The tests regex over page.tsx and console.css. They would pass even if the label span were dropped from the DOM, or if a later rule such as `.table td.num` or a `[hidden]` override in globals.css stopped the labels from showing at 640px. A render test with testing-library would check that each td contains its label text and that the athlete link and Score word are present.
suggestions.fix: Add a render test of CompareRow inside a table that asserts the label text, link href and Score word.
